Terapkan pola agentic harness patterns (Select, Write-back, Compress, Isolate) dan konsolidasi tool schema agar agent hemat konteks.

evals.prompt: Our agent pipeline crashes after 40 turns due to bloated context and file mutation conflicts between parallel subagents. Propose harness architectural patterns.

expectations: Specifies Select for progressive disclosure of skills and schemas
Specifies Write-back for file-backed state persistence protected by atomic locks
